parts.text: This question is about elements in different groups of the Periodic Table and their compounds.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Silicon is in Group IV of the Periodic Table. Explain why silicon is placed in Group IV. Give your answer in terms of electronic configuration. ............................................................................................................................................. [1]

ms.label: 5(a)
ms.text: It has 4 electrons in its outer electron shell

ms.label: 5(b)
ms.text:
solid (1)
temperature is below the melting point (1)

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) When a sample of calcium is added to a large container of cold water, a chemical reaction occurs.

ms.label: 5(d)(i)
ms.text:
any two from:
•
sinks
•
effervescence/bubbles/fizzing
•
solid gets smaller / disappears
•

white solid forms

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Complete the word equation for the reaction of calcium with water. calcium + water .................... .................... + .................... [2]

parts.text: (e) Dilute nitric acid is poured into a conical flask.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Choose the pH value of dilute nitric acid. Draw a circle around your chosen answer. pH 1 pH 7 pH 9 pH 13 [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Complete the equation for the neutralisation of an acid to produce water. State symbols are not required. H + + .................... H 2 O [1]

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) A few drops of methyl orange indicator are added to the flask containing dilute nitric acid. Solid lithium carbonate is slowly added to the flask until the indicator changes colour. State the colour change of the methyl orange indicator as the lithium carbonate is added to the dilute nitric acid in the flask. from ............................................................. to ............................................................. [2]
